label: VERIFIED
extraction: Blueprint ECC install detection and vendored standalone install. Full ECC install: verify skill present with test -f skills/blueprint/SKILL.md. Update: cd /path/to/everything-claude-code; git fetch origin main; git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main (review new commits); git checkout <reviewed-full-sha> (pin to specific reviewed commit). Vendored standalone install: copy reviewed file from ECC repository into ~/.claude/skills/blueprint/SKILL.md. Vendored copies do not have git remote; update by re-copying file from reviewed ECC commit rather than git pull. Blueprint detects git/gh availability automatically; with git+GitHub CLI generates full branch/PR/CI workflow plans; without them switches to direct mode (edit-in-place, no branches). Requirements: Claude Code for /blueprint slash command; Git+GitHub CLI optional (enables full branch/PR/CI workflow). Source: inspired by antbotlab/blueprint - upstream project and reference design.
